body:
At NIAT Jaipur, students get opportunities beyond academics through NCC and NSS programs. The National Cadet Corps (NCC) and National Service Scheme (NSS) help students develop leadership skills while serving society.


The NCC is ideal for students who want to develop discipline, confidence, leadership, and a strong sense of patriotism. Cadets take part in drills, camps, adventure activities, and social service programs. It is also highly beneficial for students interested in careers in the armed forces, police, or government services.


The NSS focuses on community service and social responsibility. Students volunteer in activities such as cleanliness drives, blood donation camps, environmental awareness programs, and rural development initiatives. It offers a great way to contribute to society while building teamwork and communication skills.


Students at NIAT x VGU who are interested in joining NCC or NSS can contact the university coordinators during the enrollment period announced by the college. Selection may include a basic registration process and orientation session.


Being part of NCC or NSS is more than an extracurricular activity—it is an opportunity to gain valuable life experiences, develop leadership qualities, and make a meaningful impact on society.
title: Can You Join NCC and NSS at NIAT Jaipur?
